response.overview: A documentary following two people through a six-month supervised protocol that combines neuroscience, contemplative practice and a psychedelic compound currently in FDA Phase 3 trials. Featuring Dr. Christof Koch and Dr. Robin Carhart-Harris, it focuses on what usually goes unfilmed: the weeks and months after the experience, when the real integration either happens or fades. Shot in London, Nepal, Venice, Mexico and the US, it also follows how the filmmakers themselves are changed by the story.
response.tagline: what if the answer isn't becoming more
response.title: Unbecoming
